about: Held-out conversations for M2.4 (deterministic rewrites, no model). Each: earlier user turns, the new message, and what a correct standalone rewrite must contain: topics (M2.1 taxonomy) and words (lowercase substrings). 'standalone': true = must be left unchanged. round_1 was written after the first rules: 7/12; its misses led to general additions (bare phrases after 'And', 'too/also', fragments, carrying every missing topic, family members adding up, a chain bug where carried acronyms were refused), so it is no longer held out. round_2 was written after those changes with stricter words: 10/10 by labels but 6/10 by reading them (a lost 'if', 'on campus' added beside 'off campus', 'in Manitoba' dropped), which led to keeping 'if', swapping a modifier of the same noun and replacing a phrase only up to the next one; so it is no longer held out either. round_3 was written after those changes and never used to change a rule: the reported figure, checked by labels and by reading.
